Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
items.summary: Researchers benchmarked AI agents on open scientific problems by having them draft follow-up papers from unpublished directions, finding that none met expert standards and most contained fabricated claims or contradictory evidence.

items.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
items.summary: SolarRenderer adapts a frozen video backbone with lightweight LoRAs to render realistic videos from diverse structural inputs in four steps or real-time streaming, using frame-aligned training data.

items.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
items.summary: AKV introduces cache engineering to manage LLM agent key-value caches without altering trajectories, improving efficiency and accuracy via drop and repos operations with a co-designed serving engine.

items.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
items.summary: DLite improves speculative decoding for agentic AI by eliminating historical context maintenance and using target hidden states for local predictions, boosting acceptance length and reducing overhead.

items.title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
items.summary: Shared meta-experts across layers reduce redundancy and improve efficiency compared to layer-specific local experts in mixture-of-experts models.

BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
items.summary: BizBench evaluates long-horizon business agents on intermediate execution validity using real-world payment procedures, revealing that frontier models frequently violate constraints despite achieving partial goal success.

items.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
items.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with low-rank adapters enables efficient adaptation of very large multimodal backbones for brain encoding, improving performance and interpretability while reducing computational cost.

items.summary: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.
